questions.query: How can I independently disable GEN-007 automatic tunnels doors and windows while preserving authored routes and old recipes?
facts: Schema 4 algorithm 5 and Arcology/Vault module v2 are opt-in; schemas 1–3 and module v1 retain legacy output.
Automatic tunnels suppress only the candidate network; authored paths and semantic passages remain explicit.
Door apertures and Arcology window glass/holes have independent controls; windows off restores structural wall material.

questions.query: How does Architectural Generator guarantee style zone coverage and connected districts for a 1024 map with 45 30 25 shares?
facts: The finite 256-block grid uses largest remainders and seeded Hilbert intervals, compiled into native categorical assignments.
Shares measure zone area, not occupied materials; the default 115/77/64 blocks achieve 44.921875/30.078125/25 percent.
One four-connected component per selected style is guaranteed, but material/player connectivity is not; quota error above 2 percentage points refuses.

questions.query: How do I select architectural styles import a custom preset generate preview paint save and reopen a CyberSand map?
facts: The focused panel is under Shared Workbench New from generator; three built-in style presets and embedded custom JSON use the existing native pipeline.
Install confirms World replacement; rejected/cancelled proposals preserve the installed World and the prior verified preview is explicitly restorable.
Project JSON embeds presets; generated-start v1 embeds the resolved recipe, verifies fresh-process native reconstruction and retains painted/erased edits without external preset files.
